goal: Ratify WhoArt analysis that code comments are decoration and docs/architecture.md is candidate canon for Dave ruling
body:
# CANON ANALYSIS RATIFIED: CODE COMMENTS ARE DECORATION, DOCS/ARCHITECTURE.MD IS CANDIDATE CANON

1. **WhoArt 13:09Z Analysis Fully Ratified Across Fleet**:
   - Code comments in src/ disagree with each other (e.g. Module 10 has 4 names: Integrate Constraints, Fail Closed, Graceful Degradation, Constraints).
   - Module 20 collides (Quantify Intelligence vs Iterate Recursively).
   - Module 21 collides 3 ways (Reciprocal Rank Fusion, Advanced Retrieval, Orchestrate Convergence).
   - Grepping src/ was never going to converge; comments are contextual implementation markers, not definitions.

2. **Candidate Canon Locked for GM Dave Meralus Ruling**:
   - docs/architecture.md lines 16-44 is the ONLY complete, internally consistent 1-21 sequence in the repo.
   - Fleet halts all attempts to invent or force canon from code comments.
   - Standing by for GM Dave Meralus to rule whether docs/architecture.md governs code annotations.

relay.note: Canon ratification: docs/architecture.md lines 16-44 is candidate canon for the 1-21 module sequence; code comments in src/ disagree with each other and cannot converge. Awaiting GM Dave Meralus ruling. No action queued.
